title: The Morning Bus
english: The morning bus is often crowded, but Maya has learned to use the time well. She listens to a short English podcast and writes down three useful expressions (/ɪkˈspreʃənz/). When the bus reaches school, she reviews her notes for a minute.
chinese: 早班公交通常很拥挤，但玛雅学会了利用这段时间。她听一段简短的英语播客，并记下三个有用表达。到学校时，她会用一分钟复习笔记。

title: A Better Study Group
english: Four students formed a study group for their science exam. Instead of reading the same chapter silently, each person explained one difficult idea to the others. The group discovered that teaching a concept made it easier to remember.
chinese: 四名学生为科学考试组成了学习小组。他们没有安静地读同一章，而是每人向其他人解释一个难点。大家发现，把概念讲出来更容易记住。

title: The Lost Notebook
english: Leo left his notebook on a bench after basketball practice. He worried all evening because it contained a week of class notes. The next morning, a younger student returned it to the office. Leo thanked him and now writes his name on every notebook.
chinese: 篮球训练后，利奥把笔记本落在长椅上。他整晚都很担心，因为里面有一周的课堂笔记。第二天早上，一名低年级学生把它交到了办公室。利奥向他道谢，现在会给每本笔记本写名字。

title: Speaking in Class
english: Nora used to avoid speaking during English class. Her teacher suggested preparing one question before every lesson. At first, her voice shook. After several weeks, asking questions became normal. She learned that confidence often grows through small repeated actions.
chinese: 诺拉过去总避免在英语课上发言。老师建议她每节课前准备一个问题。起初她的声音会发抖，几周后提问变得自然。她明白了，信心往往来自一次次小小的行动。

title: Lunchtime Music
english: Every Friday, students are allowed to play quiet music in the school courtyard during lunch. A small group takes turns choosing songs and explaining why they like them. The activity gives students a chance to share different cultures through rhythm and melody.
chinese: 每周五午餐时，学生可以在学校庭院播放安静的音乐。一个小组轮流选歌，并解释喜欢它们的原因。这项活动让学生通过节奏和旋律分享不同文化。

title: The Vegetable Garden
english: A class turned an unused corner of the playground into a vegetable garden. Students planted tomatoes and beans, then took turns watering them. They soon learned that healthy plants need patience, regular care, and enough sunlight.
chinese: 一个班级把操场闲置的角落改造成了菜园。学生们种下番茄和豆子，并轮流浇水。他们很快明白，健康的植物需要耐心、规律照料和充足阳光。

title: A Rainy Sports Day
english: Rain almost canceled the school sports day. Instead, teachers moved the events into the gym and created shorter races. Students cheered louder than ever. The change reminded everyone that a flexible plan can save an important day.
chinese: 大雨几乎让学校运动会取消。老师把项目移进体育馆，并设计了更短的比赛。学生们比以往更用力地加油。这个变化让大家明白，灵活的计划能挽救重要的一天。

title: Notes From the Library
english: The library placed small cards on tables with questions such as “What did you learn today?” Students could leave anonymous answers. By the end of the week, the board was full of ideas, book recommendations, and kind messages for other readers.
chinese: 图书馆在桌上放了小卡片，上面写着“你今天学到了什么？”等问题。学生可以匿名作答。到周末，留言板上满是想法、书籍推荐，以及给其他读者的友善信息。

title: Learning to Present
english: Sam had to present a report about city planning. He practiced with a timer and recorded himself to find unnecessary words. During the real presentation, he looked at the audience more often and used fewer slides. The focused preparation made his message clearer.
chinese: 萨姆要做一个关于城市规划的报告。他用计时器练习，并录下自己，找出多余的话。真正演讲时，他更多地看向听众，也减少了幻灯片数量。有针对性的准备让他的表达更清楚。

title: The After-School Repair Club
english: The repair club collects broken lamps, fans, and small appliances. Students first learn basic safety rules, then work with a teacher to test wires and replace simple parts. Their goal is not only to save money, but also to reduce waste.
chinese: 维修社团收集坏掉的台灯、风扇和小家电。学生们先学习基本安全规则，再在老师陪同下检查电线、更换简单零件。他们的目标不仅是省钱，也包括减少浪费。

title: A Cooler City
english: Some cities are testing lighter road surfaces to reduce extreme heat. The new material reflects more sunlight and stays cooler than traditional asphalt. Scientists are measuring temperature changes around schools and bus stops to see whether the idea works in everyday neighborhoods.
chinese: 一些城市正在测试更浅色的路面，以缓解极端高温。新材料比传统沥青反射更多阳光，温度也更低。科学家正在测量学校和公交站附近的温度变化，以判断这种方法是否适合日常社区。

title: Batteries That Last
english: Researchers are developing batteries that can store more energy in a smaller space. Better batteries could make electric buses quieter and allow phones to run longer. However, the materials must be safe, affordable, and easy to recycle before they reach wide use.
chinese: 研究人员正在开发能在更小空间储存更多电能的电池。更好的电池可以让电动公交更安静，也让手机运行更久。不过在广泛使用前，相关材料必须安全、价格合理且易于回收。

title: Listening to Whales
english: Scientists use underwater microphones to study whale sounds. The recordings reveal how groups communicate and how noise from ships affects them. By comparing quiet areas with busy shipping routes, researchers hope to design plans that protect marine animals.
chinese: 科学家用水中麦克风研究鲸鱼的声音。录音揭示了它们如何交流，以及船只噪声如何影响它们。通过比较安静海域和繁忙航线，研究人员希望设计保护海洋动物的方案。

title: A Smarter Lamp
english: A new street lamp adjusts its brightness according to weather and traffic. It becomes brighter when pedestrians approach and dims when the road is empty. The system saves electricity while keeping people safe, but the city is also checking that cameras do not collect personal data.
chinese: 一种新型路灯会根据天气和人流调整亮度。有人靠近时它会变亮，道路空无一人时则变暗。该系统既能省电又能保持安全，但城市也在确认摄像头不会收集个人数据。

title: Food Waste Diary
english: A class kept a diary of food thrown away at lunch for one week. They found that whole fruit and unfinished rice were the biggest waste. The students then started an awareness campaign and asked the kitchen to offer smaller portions upon request.
chinese: 一个班级记录了一周午餐浪费的食物。他们发现完整水果和没吃完的米饭浪费最多。随后学生们发起宣传，并请食堂在需要时提供更小份量。

title: Forests on Farms
english: Farmers in some dry regions are planting trees among crops. The trees provide shade, hold water in the soil, and create homes for birds and insects. The method requires careful planning, yet it can make farms more resilient during long periods without rain.
chinese: 一些干旱地区的农民在作物间种树。树木提供阴凉、保持土壤水分，并为鸟类和昆虫提供家园。这种方法需要仔细规划，但能帮助农场在长期无雨时更具韧性。

title: Clean Water From Fog
english: In a mountain village, large nets capture water from fog. Tiny drops collect on the mesh and flow into containers below. The system supplies extra water for gardens and washing. People still protect nearby springs because no single solution can guarantee water every day.
chinese: 在一个山村，大网从雾中收集水。微小的水滴在网面上聚集，流入下方容器。该系统为菜园和清洗提供额外水源。人们仍保护附近泉水，因为没有任何单一方案能保证每天都有水。

title: A Quieter Airport
english: An airport is testing curved flight paths to lower noise over nearby homes. Aircraft turn more gradually and avoid flying directly over the most crowded areas. Residents say the changes have helped, but the airport continues to measure sound at night and during strong winds.
chinese: 一座机场正在测试弧形航线，以降低附近住宅上空的噪声。飞机转向更平缓，并避开人口最密集的区域。居民表示变化有帮助，但机场仍在测量夜间和大风时的声音。

title: The Cooling Roof
english: A school painted its roof white to keep classrooms cooler. The paint reflects sunlight and reduced indoor temperatures during hot afternoons. Because cooling machines used less energy, the school saved money. Students now monitor temperature data and compare results across different seasons.
chinese: 一所学校把屋顶刷成白色，让教室更凉快。涂料反射阳光，降低了炎热午后的室内温度。制冷设备耗能减少，学校也节省了费用。学生们现在记录温度数据，并比较不同季节的结果。

title: Repair Instead of Replace
english: A neighborhood workshop teaches people how to fix clothes, lamps, and bicycles. Volunteers do not charge for simple advice. The project has reduced household waste and helped neighbors meet one another. Its organizers believe that practical skills should be shared across generations.
chinese: 一个社区工作坊教人们修补衣物、台灯和自行车。志愿者对简单咨询不收费。项目减少了家庭垃圾，也让邻里彼此认识。组织者相信，实用技能应当在代际之间分享。

title: Robots in the Warehouse
english: Warehouses increasingly use robots to carry heavy boxes. Sensors help the machines stop when people are nearby. Workers can then focus on checking quality and solving unexpected problems. The goal is safer work, although employees need training to cooperate with new equipment.
chinese: 仓库越来越多地使用机器人搬运重箱。传感器帮助机器在有人靠近时停下。员工可以专注于检查质量和处理突发问题。目标是让工作更安全，但员工也需要培训，才能与新设备协作。

title: A Tiny Weather Station
english: Students built a small weather station on the school roof. It records temperature, rain, and wind speed. Their science teacher sends the data to a city map used by local farmers. The project connects classroom learning with decisions made in the real world.
chinese: 学生们在学校屋顶搭建了小型气象站，记录温度、降雨和风速。科学老师把数据发送到当地农民使用的城市地图。这个项目把课堂学习与现实世界中的决策联系起来。

title: The Old Phone's Second Life
english: A technology company collects old phones and replaces weak batteries. After careful testing, the phones are donated to students who need basic devices. The project extends product life and keeps valuable metals out of landfills, but data must be erased securely first.
chinese: 一家科技公司回收旧手机并更换老化电池。经过仔细检测后，这些手机被捐赠给需要基础设备的学生。项目延长了产品寿命，也避免有价值的金属进入垃圾场，但必须先安全清除数据。

title: Mapping the Night Sky
english: A science club uses a small telescope to photograph the night sky. By comparing images taken weeks apart, students can spot changes in brightness. Light pollution from street lamps makes the task difficult, so the club also studies how lower lighting might help the observatory.
chinese: 一个科学社团用小望远镜拍摄夜空。通过比较相隔数周的照片，学生能发现亮度变化。路灯造成的光污染让任务变难，因此社团也研究减弱照明是否有助于观测。

title: The Library's Sensor
english: A library installed a sensor that measures how full each reading room is. Visitors can check the information before climbing the stairs. The system avoids long searches for empty seats. The library does not identify individuals, which keeps the service useful while protecting privacy.
chinese: 图书馆安装了传感器，测量每间阅览室的拥挤程度。访客可以在上楼前查看信息。系统让人们不用长时间寻找空座。图书馆不会识别个人身份，因此既有用又保护隐私。

title: The School Radio
english: A student radio team produces a five-minute program every morning. They share weather, school news, and study tips. Before recording, each host checks names and facts with a teacher. The show is short, but it helps students feel informed and connected.
chinese: 一个学生广播小组每天早上制作五分钟节目，分享天气、校园新闻和学习建议。录音前，每位主持都会和老师核对姓名与事实。节目虽短，却让学生更了解校园，也更有归属感。

title: Books Without a Price
english: The community center created a book exchange shelf near its front door. Readers may take one book and leave another. Popular novels disappear quickly, while cookbooks stay longer. Volunteers organize the shelf each Sunday and remove damaged copies.
chinese: 社区中心在正门附近设置了图书交换架。读者可以拿走一本书，再留下一本书。热门小说很快被拿走，烹饪书则停留更久。志愿者每周日整理书架，并撤下破损的书。

title: An Hour of Help
english: Every Saturday, several adults spend one hour helping older neighbors with phones and computers. They teach basic tasks such as video calls, photo sharing, and checking train times. The service is free, and the conversations often become as valuable as the technical help.
chinese: 每周六，一些成年人会花一小时帮助年长邻居使用手机和电脑。他们教视频通话、分享照片、查询火车时间等基本操作。服务免费，而聊天往往和技术帮助同样珍贵。

title: At the Local Market
english: The local market opens early and closes before noon. Farmers bring seasonal vegetables, while bakers sell fresh bread. Shoppers carry their own bags to reduce plastic waste. Although the market is small, it gives the neighborhood a friendly place to meet.
chinese: 当地市场清晨开门，中午前收摊。农民带来时令蔬菜，面包师出售新鲜面包。顾客自带袋子以减少塑料垃圾。市场虽小，却给社区提供了友好的相聚空间。

title: A Safer Walk Home
english: Residents asked the city to improve a dark path used by students after school. New lamps now light the crossing, and trees near the corner were trimmed. The city also reduced the speed limit. Parents say the route feels safer, but students are still encouraged to walk together.
chinese: 居民请求城市改善学生放学后经过的昏暗小路。新增路灯照亮路口，转角附近的树枝也被修剪。城市还降低了限速。家长说路线更安全了，但仍鼓励学生结伴同行。

title: Cleaning the Riverside
english: Volunteers gathered beside the river to collect plastic bottles and food packaging. They separated recyclable materials from general waste and recorded what they found. The next event will focus on asking nearby shops to use fewer single-use containers.
chinese: 志愿者在河边集合，收集塑料瓶和食品包装。他们把可回收物与普通垃圾分类，并记录发现的东西。下一次活动将重点推动附近商店减少一次性容器。

title: The Repair Café
english: At a monthly repair café, people bring small objects that no longer work. Volunteers inspect them and explain what can be fixed. Some visitors learn to replace a plug or sew a torn bag themselves. The café saves useful items and spreads practical skills.
chinese: 在每月一次的维修咖啡馆，人们带来不能使用的小物件。志愿者检查并解释哪些地方可以修。有些访客学会自己换插头或缝补破包。咖啡馆既挽救有用物品，也传播实用技能。

title: A Museum in Your Pocket
english: A local museum released an audio guide for visitors using their own phones. Each room has a short story told by a historian or an artist. The guide includes a transcript for people who cannot hear the recording, making the exhibition easier to enjoy.
chinese: 一家地方博物馆推出了使用游客自己手机播放的语音导览。每个展厅都有历史学家或艺术家讲述的短故事。导览还提供文字稿，方便听不见录音的人，也让展览更容易欣赏。

title: The Street Festival
english: The annual street festival combined food, music, and handmade crafts. Local families shared recipes from different regions, while musicians performed in the square. Organizers used reusable plates and arranged extra rubbish bins. The event brought many cultures together without losing their differences.
chinese: 一年一度的街头节把食物、音乐和手工艺结合起来。当地家庭分享来自不同地区的食谱，音乐家在广场表演。主办方使用可重复使用的盘子，并增设垃圾桶。活动让多种文化相聚，同时保留各自特色。

title: Why Keep a Journal
english: Writing a short journal entry each evening can clear a busy mind. You do not need perfect sentences. A few details about what happened, what you noticed, and what you want to do next are enough. Over time, the pages show changes that are hard to notice day by day.
chinese: 每晚写一段简短日记能理清忙碌的思绪。你不需要写完美的句子，只需记录发生了什么、注意到了什么、接下来想做什么。时间久了，这些页面会呈现日常中难以察觉的变化。

title: Stories From Grandparents
english: Students interviewed their grandparents about childhood games and family meals. They recorded the conversations and wrote short summaries in both Chinese and English. The project helped young people understand how daily life has changed and which traditions still matter.
chinese: 学生们采访祖父母，了解他们童年的游戏和家庭饭菜。他们录下谈话，并用中英文写下简短摘要。这个项目帮助年轻人理解日常生活如何改变，以及哪些传统仍然重要。

title: Learning a Family Language
english: Ana's family speaks a regional language at home, but she mainly uses Mandarin at school. She began recording simple conversations with her grandmother and practicing ten new words each week. The recordings preserve pronunciation and family stories that a dictionary cannot fully explain.
chinese: 安娜的家人家里说一种地方语言，但她在学校主要使用普通话。她开始录下与祖母的简单对话，每周练习十个新词。录音保留了字典无法完整解释的发音和家庭故事。

title: The Swapping Shelf
english: Residents turned an old cabinet into a swapping shelf for books, seeds, and small tools. A note explains that every borrowed object should return within two weeks. The shelf relies on trust rather than rules. Most items return, and neighbors have started leaving helpful labels.
chinese: 居民把旧柜子改造成交换架，用来交换书、种子和小工具。告示说明借出的物品应在两周内归还。架子依赖信任而非严格规定。大多数物品都会归还，邻居们也开始留下有用标签。

title: A Wall of Color
english: An empty wall beside the sports center became a public art project. Young artists painted scenes of people walking, playing, and cooking together. Before starting, they asked residents which local places should appear. The finished wall now reflects the neighborhood rather than one artist's idea.
chinese: 运动中心旁的一面空墙变成了公共艺术项目。年轻艺术家画出人们散步、运动和一起做饭的场景。动工前，他们询问居民希望出现哪些本地地点。完成的墙面展现的是社区，而不是某位艺术家的单方面想法。

title: Mapping Friendly Places
english: A group of teenagers mapped places where people can sit for free. The map marks shaded benches, public water fountains, and quiet reading corners. They checked every location themselves and noted opening hours. Visitors now use the map when they need a short rest.
chinese: 一群青少年绘制了可以免费休息的地图，标出阴凉长椅、公共饮水处和安静阅读角。他们亲自检查每个地点并记录开放时间。游客现在会在需要短暂休息时使用这张地图。

title: Sleep Before Screens
english: Many students keep their phones beside the bed and check messages late at night. Sleep experts suggest charging devices outside the bedroom and keeping a regular bedtime. A calm routine, such as reading a paper book, can help the brain slow down before sleep.
chinese: 许多学生把手机放在床边，深夜还查看消息。睡眠专家建议在卧室外充电，并保持规律的就寝时间。阅读纸质书等安静习惯能帮助大脑在睡前慢下来。

title: A Better Breakfast
english: A balanced breakfast does not need to be complicated. Whole grain bread, an egg, fruit, or yogurt can provide energy for the morning. People who skip breakfast because they are busy may prepare something simple the night before. Small changes are easier to keep than perfect plans.
chinese: 均衡早餐不必复杂。全麦面包、鸡蛋、水果或酸奶都能为上午提供能量。因为忙碌而不吃早餐的人可以前一晚准备简单食物。小改变往往比完美计划更容易坚持。

title: Ten Minutes Outside
english: Spending ten minutes outside during a study break can improve attention. A short walk changes posture, gives the eyes a wider view, and exposes the body to natural light. The break does not need to be exercise. Even walking to a quiet corner can help.
chinese: 学习间隙到户外待十分钟能改善注意力。短暂散步会改变姿势，让眼睛看到更远处，也让身体接触自然光。休息不一定非要运动，即使走到安静角落也有帮助。

title: The Twenty-Twenty Rule
english: When using a screen, some students follow the twenty-twenty rule: every twenty minutes, look about six meters away for twenty seconds. It gives tired eye muscles a chance to relax. Remembering the rule is easier when a timer or study partner helps.
chinese: 使用屏幕时，一些学生会遵循“二十二十”规则：每二十分钟看向约六米外，持续二十秒。这能让疲劳的眼部肌肉放松。有计时器或学习伙伴提醒时，更容易记住规则。

title: Drink Before You Are Thirsty
english: Thirst is not always a perfect reminder to drink water. Students may forget during a long lesson or sports practice. Keeping a bottle nearby and drinking small amounts regularly can make hydration easier. Water is usually enough for ordinary school activities.
chinese: 口渴并不总是补水的完美提醒。学生在长时间上课或运动时可能忘记喝水。把水瓶放在身边，并规律地少量饮水，会让补水更容易。普通校园活动通常喝水就够了。

title: A Minute of Breathing
english: Before a test, the body may become tense even when the mind knows the material. Slow breathing can reduce the physical stress response. Try breathing in for four counts and out for six. Repeat a few times, then return to the first question without expecting perfection.
chinese: 考试前，即使大脑掌握了内容，身体也可能紧张。缓慢呼吸能降低身体的压力反应。试着吸气四拍、呼气六拍，重复几次，然后回到第一题，不要求自己做到完美。

title: Strength for Everyday Life
english: Strength training is not only for athletes. Carrying bags, standing up from a chair, and climbing stairs all require strength. Beginners can practice safe movements such as sit-to-stands and wall push-ups. Progress should be steady, comfortable, and supervised when needed.
chinese: 力量训练不只属于运动员。提包、从椅子上站起和爬楼都需要力量。初学者可以练习安全动作，如椅子起立和扶墙俯卧撑。进步应稳定、舒适，需要时接受指导。

title: Shade and Sunscreen
english: Outdoor activities are healthy, but strong sunlight can damage skin. Students can wear hats, seek shade at lunch, and apply sunscreen before sports. Protection matters even on cloudy days because some ultraviolet light passes through clouds. Repeated small habits protect the skin over many years.
chinese: 户外活动有益健康，但强烈阳光会伤害皮肤。学生可以戴帽子、午餐时寻找阴凉，并在运动前涂防晒。阴天也需要防护，因为部分紫外线会穿过云层。长期重复的小习惯能保护皮肤。

title: Wash Your Hands for Twenty Seconds
english: Hands touch desks, doors, phones, and food throughout the day. Washing with soap for about twenty seconds helps remove germs. People often miss fingertips and thumbs. A simple routine, including washing after the toilet and before eating, prevents many avoidable illnesses.
chinese: 一天中，手会接触课桌、门、手机和食物。用肥皂洗手约二十秒有助于去除细菌。人们常漏掉指尖和拇指。便后、餐前洗手等简单习惯能预防许多可避免的疾病。

title: A Real Rest From Messages
english: A short digital break can reduce the feeling of always being available. Choose one meal or the last thirty minutes before bed when notifications stay off. Tell people in advance if they may need you urgently. The purpose is not to disappear, but to let attention rest.
chinese: 短暂的数字休息能减少一直在线待命的压力。选择一顿饭或睡前最后三十分钟关闭通知。提前告诉可能急需联系你的人。目的不是消失，而是让注意力休息。

title: The First Part-Time Job
english: Mia's first part-time job taught her more than how to use a cash register. She learned to arrive on time, ask questions when instructions were unclear, and stay calm during busy periods. At the end of each shift, she wrote down one thing that went well and one thing to improve.
chinese: 米娅的第一份兼职不仅教会她使用收银机，还让她学会准时到岗、在指示不清楚时提问，以及在繁忙时段保持冷静。每次下班后，她都会写下一件做得好的事和一件要改进的事。

title: A Team That Listens
english: A successful team does not need everyone to think in the same way. It needs people to listen before they answer. In one project meeting, members wrote their ideas down first so quieter voices could be heard. The group found a solution that no single person had proposed alone.
chinese: 成功的团队不需要每个人想法一致，而需要先倾听再回应。一次项目会议上，成员先写下想法，让较安静的人也能被听见。团队最终找到了没有任何人单独提出的解决方案。

title: Feedback Without Fear
english: Useful feedback describes behavior instead of attacking a person. For example, “The report arrived late” is clearer than “You are careless.” A good response is to ask what should change next time. Treating feedback as information can turn criticism into a practical plan.
chinese: 有用的反馈描述行为，而不是攻击个人。例如，“报告迟交了”比“你很粗心”更清楚。好的回应是询问下次应如何改变。把反馈当作信息，可以把批评转化为实际计划。

title: The Interview Question
english: During a job interview, a manager asked, “Tell us about a problem you solved.” One candidate described the situation, the action taken, and the result. Specific details were more convincing than general claims. The manager later said the clear story helped the team understand how the candidate worked.
chinese: 面试时，经理问：“请讲一个你解决过的问题。”一位应聘者描述了情境、采取的行动和结果。具体细节比笼统的自我评价更有说服力。经理后来说，清楚的故事让团队理解了这位应聘者的工作方式。

title: Planning Backward
english: When a deadline feels far away, planning backward can help. Start with the final date, then identify the last task, the task before that, and all required checks. This method reveals hidden work, such as editing or waiting for approval. It also shows whether the first step must begin today.
chinese: 当截止日期看似很远时，可以从终点倒推计划。先确定最终日期，再找出最后一项任务、前一项任务和所有必要检查。这个方法会显出编辑、等待审批等隐藏工作，也能判断第一步是否必须今天开始。

title: When Plans Change
english: A supplier suddenly changed the delivery date, putting a project at risk. Instead of blaming one person, the team listed three possible responses: reduce the first release, find another supplier, or change the order of work. They chose the third option and told customers early.
chinese: 供应商突然更改交货日期，使项目面临风险。团队没有责怪某个人，而是列出三种可能应对：缩减首发内容、寻找其他供应商或调整工作顺序。他们选择第三种，并提前告知客户。

title: Learning a New Career
english: After years in an office, Daniel decided to train as an electrician. He studied basic theory at night and practiced under an experienced worker during weekends. The change was difficult because his income fell for several months. However, he preferred learning a skill that allowed him to solve practical problems.
chinese: 在办公室工作多年后，丹尼尔决定接受电工培训。他晚上学习基础理论，周末在有经验的工人指导下实践。转变很困难，因为收入下降了几个月。但他更喜欢学习一项能解决实际问题的技能。

title: Skills From Volunteering
english: Volunteering at a community event gave Lin experience in communication and planning. She welcomed guests, solved small problems, and wrote a short report afterward. These activities were not part of a formal job, but they became useful examples in later interviews because they showed responsibility and teamwork.
chinese: 参与社区活动志愿服务让林获得了沟通和计划经验。她接待来宾、处理小问题，并在之后写简短报告。这些活动不是正式工作，却成为后来面试中的有用例子，因为它们体现了责任感和团队合作。

title: A Better Online Meeting
english: Online meetings work better when everyone knows the purpose in advance. A clear agenda helps people prepare and keeps the discussion focused. The host should also leave time for questions. Turning on cameras is optional; attention matters more than appearance. Ending with specific assignments prevents confusion later.
chinese: 当每个人提前知道目的时，线上会议会更有效。清楚的议程帮助人们准备并保持讨论集中。主持人还应留出提问时间。开摄像头应可选，专注比外表更重要。最后明确任务能避免后续混乱。

title: A Small Shop's Big Choice
english: A small bakery wanted to sell online but did not have enough staff to deliver orders. The owners began with pre-orders for weekend pickup. This limited experiment required little extra cost and revealed which products customers really wanted. After three months, they expanded the system carefully.
chinese: 一家小面包店想在线上销售，但人手不足以配送。店主先从周末自提预售开始。这个小实验额外成本低，还能看出顾客真正想要哪些产品。三个月后，他们谨慎地扩大系统。

title: Paying With a Phone
english: Mobile payment is convenient, but speed can make spending feel invisible. One student now checks the total before tapping and reviews purchases every evening. Budgeting apps can help, yet a simple weekly limit may be easier to follow. Convenience works best when it is paired with awareness.
chinese: 手机支付很方便，但速度也会让消费变得没有感觉。一名学生现在付款前会确认金额，每晚回顾支出。预算应用有帮助，但简单的每周限额可能更容易坚持。便利与觉察结合时效果最好。

title: Saving a Little
english: Saving does not require a large income. Setting aside a small amount each week can build a useful emergency fund. The money should be easy to access but separate from daily spending. People are more likely to save when the habit is automatic and the goal is specific.
chinese: 储蓄不需要高收入。每周存一点钱可以建立有用的应急基金。这笔钱应容易取用，又与日常消费分开。当习惯自动化且目标具体时，人们更可能坚持储蓄。

title: Reading an Advertisement
english: Advertisements often show a perfect result, but they do not always explain the cost of reaching it. Before buying, ask whether the product solves a real need and whether another choice would work. Looking for the total price, return policy, and delivery cost can prevent an exciting image from becoming an expensive mistake.
chinese: 广告常展示完美结果，却不总说明达到它要付出的代价。购买前，问问产品是否解决真实需要，是否有其他选择。查看总价、退货政策和配送费，能避免一张诱人的图片变成昂贵的错误。

title: The Five-Day Wait
english: A student wants an expensive jacket. Instead of buying it immediately, he waits five days and uses the jacket he already owns. If he still needs it after a week, he compares prices and checks quality. The delay removes many impulse purchases without making every decision difficult.
chinese: 一名学生想买一件昂贵外套。他没有立刻下单，而是先等五天，并继续穿已有的外套。一周后如果仍需要，他再比较价格、检查质量。这个延迟消除了很多冲动消费，又不会让所有决定都变得困难。

title: Repair or Replace
english: When a product breaks, the cheapest price is not always the lowest total cost. A repair may extend its life and keep useful materials in service. Replacement can be reasonable if repairs are unsafe or impossible. Comparing both choices, including time and environmental impact, leads to better decisions.
chinese: 产品坏掉时，最低标价不一定意味着最低总成本。维修能延长寿命，让有用材料继续发挥作用。如果维修不安全或不可能，更换也可能合理。比较两种选择的时间与环境影响，能带来更好的决定。

title: Packing Light
english: Packing light becomes easier when travelers choose clothes that work together. Two pairs of shoes and several layers are often enough for a short trip. Heavy items should go near the back and important documents should stay in one reachable place. A smaller bag also makes trains and stairs less stressful.
chinese: 当旅行者选择能互相搭配的衣服时，轻装会更容易。短途旅行通常两双鞋和几件可叠穿衣物就够。重物应靠近背部，重要证件放在容易拿到的一个位置。较小的包也让乘火车和走楼梯更轻松。

title: The Slow Train
english: The slow train takes two hours longer than the express, but it passes through small towns and quiet fields. Passengers can open the window, buy food at station stops, and talk with local travelers. Sometimes the journey becomes a meaningful part of the trip rather than a delay.
chinese: 慢车比快车多花两小时，却会穿过小镇和安静田野。乘客可以开窗、在停站时买食物，并与当地旅客交谈。有时旅程本身就是旅行中有意义的一部分，而不是延误。

title: Walking the City
english: Walking is one of the best ways to understand a city. The pace lets you notice shop signs, small gardens, and changes in the street. A useful route connects a market, a park, and a quiet square. Comfortable shoes matter more than a perfect plan.
chinese: 步行是了解一座城市的最好方式之一。这个速度让你注意到店招、小花园和街道变化。一条好路线可以连接市场、公园和安静广场。舒适的鞋比完美计划更重要。

title: A Museum Town
english: One small town has six museums, each run by local volunteers. Visitors can buy one ticket and walk between a railway museum, a textile museum, and a tiny art gallery. The museums are not huge, but they preserve stories that larger city institutions often overlook.
chinese: 一座小镇有六家博物馆，每家都由当地志愿者运营。游客买一张票就能参观铁路博物馆、纺织博物馆和一家小画廊。博物馆不大，却保存了大型城市机构常忽略的故事。

title: The Missing Suitcase
english: When the airline could not find his suitcase, Tom reported the bag immediately and kept his receipt. He packed medicine and a charger in his carry-on, so the first night was manageable. The suitcase arrived two days later. The experience taught him to label luggage clearly and keep essentials nearby.
chinese: 航空公司找不到托运行李时，汤姆立即申报并保留收据。他把药品和充电器放在随身行李里，所以第一晚还能应付。两天后行李送到。这次经历让他学会清楚标记箱包，并把必需品放在身边。

title: Breakfast in a New Place
english: Trying a local breakfast can reveal how people start their day. In one town, workers gather around a tiny shop for warm noodles before sunrise. Visitors should ask about ingredients and choose a busy place with quick turnover. The meal is simple, but the routine tells a story.
chinese: 尝试当地早餐能了解人们如何开始一天。在一个小镇，工人们天亮前会聚在小店吃热面。游客应询问配料，并选择客流快、生意忙的店。食物简单，但日常习惯讲述着故事。

title: Tourism and the Old Street
english: An old street became popular with tourists, bringing new income to local shops. It also increased noise and rent. The city responded by limiting large tour groups during certain hours and supporting residents who wanted to keep traditional businesses open. Success now depends on balancing visits with daily life.
chinese: 一条老街受到游客欢迎，为本地商店带来了新收入，也增加了噪声和租金。城市限制某些时段的大型旅游团，并支持愿意保留传统生意的居民。现在的成功取决于平衡旅游与日常生活。

title: The Night Train
english: The night train leaves the city after dark and arrives in the mountains early the next morning. Passengers sleep while the landscape changes outside. Some people prefer a faster flight, but the train saves a hotel night and turns travel time into rest. Light packing makes the small room easier to manage.
chinese: 夜车天黑后离开城市，第二天清晨抵达山区。乘客睡觉时，窗外景色不断变化。有人更喜欢更快的航班，但火车省下一晚住宿，并把途中时间变成休息。轻装能让小包厢更容易整理。

title: When the Map Is Offline
english: A phone map is useful until the battery or signal disappears. Travelers should download an offline map and note the address of their accommodation. Asking a shop worker for directions can also confirm whether the route is safe. A paper map provides a backup and shows connections that a small screen may hide.
chinese: 手机地图在没电或没信号时就失效。旅行者应下载离线地图，并记住宿地址。向店员问路还能确认路线是否安全。纸质地图可作备份，也能展示小屏幕可能隐藏的连接道路。

title: Three Lines a Day
english: A travel journal does not need long descriptions. Three lines a day can record a place, a conversation, and something surprising. These details later bring back the feeling of the trip more vividly than a list of famous attractions. Taking a photo of a local sign can also preserve context.
chinese: 旅行日记不必写很长。每天三行就能记录一个地点、一次对话和一件意外发现。日后这些细节比著名景点清单更能生动唤起旅行感受。拍下当地标牌也能保留背景。

title: One Minute Before Training
english: A short warm-up can prepare the body without using too much energy. One minute of easy marching, arm circles, or shoulder movements is enough before a simple workout. The purpose is to increase comfort and awareness, not to become tired before the main activity begins.
chinese: 简短热身能准备身体，又不会消耗太多体力。简单训练前，一分钟原地踏步、绕臂或肩部活动就够了。目的是提高舒适度和身体觉察，而不是在主动作开始前就疲劳。

title: Finding a Pace
english: A pace that feels too fast at the beginning often becomes impossible to maintain. Runners should choose a speed at which they can still speak a short sentence. Walking briefly is not failure; it helps keep the whole session steady. Consistent practice matters more than one impressive start.
chinese: 开始时太快的速度往往难以维持。跑者应选择还能说出短句的速度。短暂步行不是失败，而是帮助整个训练保持稳定。持续练习比一次惊人的起步更重要。

title: Writing Down Strength Work
english: Recording sets and repetitions helps people see progress that is hard to notice from day to day. A notebook can include the exercise, weight, and how difficult the final repetition felt. This information guides the next session and prevents someone from adding too much work too quickly.
chinese: 记录组数和次数能让人看到日常难以察觉的进步。笔记本可以写下动作、重量和最后一次有多困难。这些信息指导下一次训练，也避免过快增加训练量。

title: The Player Who Passed
english: In the final minute of a basketball game, one player had an open shot but passed to a teammate in a better position. The teammate scored, and the team won. The coach praised the decision because it showed that good teamwork can matter more than personal attention.
chinese: 篮球赛最后一分钟，一名球员有空位投篮机会，却把球传给位置更好的队友。队友得分，球队获胜。教练称赞这个决定，因为它说明良好的团队配合有时比个人关注更重要。

title: Rest Is Part of Training
english: Muscles adapt during recovery, not only during exercise. A hard training day should be followed by easier activity or rest. Sleep, food, and relaxed breathing help the body repair. People who ignore recovery may feel slower and lose motivation even when they train often.
chinese: 肌肉不仅在运动中适应，也在恢复时变强。高强度训练后应安排轻松活动或休息。睡眠、食物和放松呼吸帮助身体修复。忽视恢复的人即使常训练，也可能变慢并失去动力。

title: Running After Rain
english: After rain, a park path can be slippery. Runners should slow down and watch for wet leaves and uneven ground. Light shoes with enough grip are more useful than expensive clothing. If lightning is nearby, the safest choice is to leave the open area immediately.
chinese: 雨后公园小路可能湿滑。跑者应减速，注意湿叶和不平地面。具有足够抓地力的轻便鞋比昂贵衣物更有用。如果附近有闪电，最安全的是立即离开开阔区域。

title: A Safer Ride
english: Before cycling, check the brakes, tires, and lights. A helmet should fit closely without blocking vision. Riders must follow traffic signals and keep enough distance from parked cars. Bright clothing and a light make it easier for drivers to notice the bicycle in low light.
chinese: 骑车前检查刹车、轮胎和车灯。头盔应贴合且不遮挡视线。骑行者必须遵守交通信号，并与停放车辆保持足够距离。亮色衣物和车灯能让司机在弱光下更容易发现自行车。

title: Breathing in the Pool
english: New swimmers often try to hold their breath too long. A steady rhythm is easier: breathe out slowly in the water, then turn for air. Practice near the side of the pool with supervision. Relaxing the shoulders reduces unnecessary effort and helps the body stay level.
chinese: 初学游泳的人常试图憋气太久。稳定节奏更容易：水中慢慢呼气，然后转头换气。应在泳池边、有人看护下练习。放松肩膀能减少多余用力，让身体更平。

title: Training and Sleep
english: Training places stress on the body, while sleep supports repair and learning. Students who train late may find it hard to fall asleep if they remain highly excited. A calm routine, dim light, and a regular bedtime can help. More training cannot replace the recovery that sleep provides.
chinese: 训练给身体带来压力，睡眠支持修复和学习。晚间训练的学生如果持续兴奋，可能难以入睡。安静习惯、昏暗灯光和规律作息能帮助。更多训练不能替代睡眠提供的恢复。

title: Losing With Respect
english: After a close match, the losing team lined up to shake hands. One captain said the result was disappointing but the effort was clear. The players watched the final minutes again and found two choices to improve. Respect after a loss builds trust for the next competition.
chinese: 一场接近的比赛后，失利球队排队握手。一位队长说结果令人失望，但努力很明显。队员们重看最后几分钟，找出两个可改进的选择。输球后的尊重会为下一次比赛建立信任。

title: Checking a News Story
english: A surprising news story can spread quickly, but speed is not proof that it is true. Readers should look for the original source, the publication date, and a second independent report. Photos may also be reused from another event. Pausing to check prevents false information from spreading.
chinese: 惊人的新闻可能迅速传播，但速度快并不证明它真实。读者应寻找原始来源、发布日期和第二条独立报道。照片也可能来自另一事件。停下来核查能阻止错误信息传播。

title: Beyond the Headline
english: Headlines are short because space is limited, but they cannot explain every detail. A serious report may contain conditions that disappear from its title. Reading the first few paragraphs usually reveals who said what, when it happened, and why it matters. A headline should open a question, not end thinking.
chinese: 标题因为空间有限而简短，但无法解释所有细节。严肃报道可能包含在标题中消失的前提。阅读前几段通常能看出谁说了什么、何时发生、为何重要。标题应开启问题，而不是终止思考。

title: A Feed You Control
english: Social media feeds are shaped by what people watch, pause on, and react to. This can make some topics appear more common than they are. Users can improve their feed by muting distracting accounts and following reliable sources. A deliberate list is more useful than an endless recommendation stream.
chinese: 社交媒体信息流受人们观看、停留和互动的内容影响。这可能让某些话题显得比实际更普遍。用户可以通过屏蔽干扰账号、关注可靠来源来改善信息流。有意识的选择比无尽推荐更有用。

title: Before Posting a Video
english: A short video can leave a strong impression, but it often removes context. Before posting, check whether other people can be identified and whether a joke may harm someone. Music and images may also belong to their creators. Publishing responsibly means thinking about the people who will appear in the background.
chinese: 短视频能留下强烈印象，却常删去背景。发布前要确认是否能识别其他人，以及玩笑是否会伤害别人。音乐和图片也可能属于创作者。负责任地发布意味着考虑出现在背景中的人。

title: How Recommendations Work
english: Recommendation systems compare patterns in what many users choose. They do not truly understand a person's goals. A system may show more of the same content because it predicts attention, not because the content is accurate. Users should decide when a recommendation is helpful and when they need a different source.
chinese: 推荐系统比较大量用户选择的模式。它们并不真正理解个人目标。系统可能展示更多相同内容，是因为预测会吸引注意力，而不是因为内容准确。用户应判断推荐何时有帮助，何时需要换个来源。

title: Fact, Opinion, and Evidence
english: A fact can be checked, while an opinion describes what someone believes or prefers. Many articles mix both. Readers can separate them by asking, “How do we know?” Evidence may include data, direct observation, or a named source. This simple question makes complex stories easier to evaluate.
chinese: 事实可以核查，观点则描述某人的信念或偏好。许多文章把两者混在一起。读者可以问“我们怎么知道？”来区分。证据可能包括数据、直接观察或具名来源。这个简单问题能让复杂报道更容易判断。

title: Why Podcasts Feel Personal
english: Podcasts often feel personal because listeners hear a voice for many minutes. This closeness can build trust, but it can also make advertisements sound like friendly advice. Listeners should notice when a host is being paid to recommend something and compare the claim with independent information before making a purchase.
chinese: 播客常显得亲切，因为听众会连续几分钟听到一个声音。这种亲近能建立信任，也可能让广告听起来像朋友建议。听众应注意到主持人是否因推荐而获得报酬，并在购买前用独立信息核对说法。

title: A Photo Is a Choice
english: A photograph looks like a direct record, but the photographer chooses the frame, timing, and direction. A crowded street can appear empty if the camera points toward one quiet corner. Understanding these choices helps viewers read images critically rather than assuming every picture tells the complete story.
chinese: 照片看起来像直接记录，但摄影者选择了画面、时机和方向。如果镜头对准一个安静角落，拥挤街道也能显得空无一人。理解这些选择能帮助观众批判地看图，而不是认为每张照片都讲述了完整故事。

title: Translation and Context
english: Machine translation can give a quick understanding of a sentence, but it may miss humor, tone, or local meaning. A literal translation is not always the best one. For important messages, people should check names, numbers, and cultural references with a human speaker when possible.
chinese: 机器翻译能快速帮助理解句子，却可能漏掉幽默、语气或当地含义。直译不一定最好。处理重要信息时，应尽可能请会这门语言的人核对姓名、数字和文化指涉。

title: The Cost of Free Apps
english: A free app may earn money through advertisements or by collecting data. Before installing one, check what information it requests and whether those permissions match its purpose. A simple game rarely needs access to contacts. Reading the privacy summary can prevent convenience from becoming an unexpected trade.
chinese: 免费应用可能通过广告或收集数据赚钱。安装前，应检查它请求哪些信息，以及权限是否符合用途。简单游戏很少需要访问联系人。阅读隐私摘要能防止便利变成意外的交换。

title: A Digital Library Card
english: A local library now lets members borrow e-books and audiobooks through an app. Items return automatically after the loan period, so there are no late fees. The service is helpful for commuters, but popular titles still have waiting lists. Librarians can show readers how to use the system safely.
chinese: 当地图书馆现在允许会员通过应用借阅电子书和有声书。借期结束后会自动归还，因此没有逾期费。这项服务对方便通勤者很有用，但热门书仍需等待。图书管理员可以教读者安全使用系统。

title: A Robot at the Door
english: A university campus began testing small delivery robots for meals and library books. The robots travel on sidewalks and stop when people cross their path. Users receive a code to open the compartment. Staff are monitoring safety, especially near bicycles and busy entrances.
chinese: 一所大学校园开始测试小型配送机器人，用来送餐和送图书馆书籍。机器人在人行道行驶，有人横穿时停下。用户收到开箱码。工作人员正监测安全，尤其是自行车和繁忙入口附近。

title: Solar Panels at School
english: A school installed solar panels above two classroom buildings. The system supplies part of the electricity used for lights and computers. A display shows how much clean energy is produced each day. Students will compare that number with weather conditions and learn how energy use changes by season.
chinese: 一所学校在两栋教学楼上方安装了太阳能板。系统为照明和电脑提供部分电力。显示屏展示每天产生多少清洁能源。学生将把数字与天气比较，并了解能源使用如何随季节变化。

title: Shared Bikes Return
english: A bike-sharing program added designated parking areas near bus stops. Earlier, bicycles sometimes blocked doors and sidewalks. Users now receive a reminder to lock the bike inside a marked zone. The city reports fewer complaints, although damaged bicycles are still collected for repair each week.
chinese: 共享单车项目在公交站附近增设指定停车区。此前，自行车有时会挡住门口和人行道。用户现在会收到将车锁在标记区域内的提醒。城市表示投诉减少，但每周仍有损坏车辆被收走维修。

title: The Town Newspaper
english: A small town newspaper reduced its print schedule from daily to twice a week but expanded local reporting online. It now covers council meetings, school events, and changes in public transport. Readers pay a low monthly fee, which supports a reporter. The editor says reliable local news needs both attention and financial support.
chinese: 一家小镇报纸把印刷频率从每日减少到每周两次，却扩大了线上本地报道。它现在覆盖议会会议、学校活动和公共交通变化。读者支付较低月费，用于支持一名记者。编辑说，可靠的本地新闻既需要关注，也需要资金支持。
